articles.summary: Magnite, the largest independent sell-side advertising company, today announced that Business Insider has selected its SpringServe video platform to power ad serving and programmatic monetization of the publisher’s standalone CTV channel.
articles.title: Business Insider Launches Standalone FAST Channel, Partners with Magnite’s SpringServe for Next Phase of Streaming Growth

articles.summary: Magnite today announced that it has achieved certification from the Japan Joint Industry Committee for Digital Advertising Quality & Qualify (JICDAQ), demonstrating that it complies with the organization’s established standards around brand safety and invalid traffic prevention.
articles.title: Magnite Achieves JICDAQ Certification for Brand Safety and Invalid Traffic Prevention in Japan
